# E0337: an _each is not _each(source list, body)

each takes two arguments: a reference to a list in the source instance, and a
body of mappings over `item`, applied to each element.

## Example

`ship/history/0.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		title: string
	}]
}
```

`ship/history/1.0.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{
		name: string
	}]
}

ForwardLens: {
	v0_0: _
	v1_0: {
		items: _each(v0_0.items)
	}
}
```

`ship/tip.thema`:

```cue
Schema: {
	items: [...{name: string}]
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0337]: _each takes two arguments: _each(v0_0.<list>, {...})
  --> history/1.0.thema:10:10
   |
10 |         items: _each(v0_0.items)
   |                ^^^^^
   |
```
